## Core Team

The ggseg suite is primarily developed and maintained by [Athanasia Mo Mowinckel](https://drmowinckels.io), and core concept and initial prototype by [Didac Vidal-Piñeiro](https://www.sv.uio.no/psi/personer/vit/didacvp/).

## All Contributors {.section-header}

Thank you to everyone who has contributed to the ggseg ecosystem.

## How to Contribute

We welcome contributions of all kinds:

- **Bug reports**: Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/ggseg/ggseg/issues)
- **Feature requests**: Have an idea? [Start a discussion](https://github.com/orgs/ggseg/discussions)
- **Code contributions**: Check out the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/ggseg/ggseg/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- **New atlases**: Want to add a brain atlas? See [ggsegExtra documentation](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegExtra/)
